items.question: How many customers have unpaid invoices overdue by more than 90 days, as of the latest invoice date?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH latest_invoice AS (
    SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS LatestDocDate
    FROM IV
    WHERE Cancelled = 'F'
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        k.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(k.Amount) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS k
    JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.DebtorCode) AS CustomerCount
FROM IV AS i
CROSS JOIN latest_invoice AS l
LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON p.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
  AND julianday(l.LatestDocDate) - julianday(i.DueDate) > 90
  AND i.TotalIncTax - COALESCE(p.PaidAmount, 0) > 0;

B3.sql:
WITH latest_invoice AS (
    SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS LatestDocDate
    FROM IV
    WHERE Cancelled = 'F'
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        k.InvoiceDocKey,
        SUM(k.Amount) AS PaidAmount
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff AS k
    JOIN ARPayment AS p
        ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
       AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.DebtorCode) AS CustomerCount
FROM IV AS i
CROSS JOIN latest_invoice AS l
LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON p.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
  AND julianday(l.LatestDocDate) - julianday(i.DueDate) > 90
  AND i.TotalIncTax - COALESCE(p.PaidAmount, 0) > 0;
